llm.title: LLM Central Hub
llm.desc: Configure realtime conversational models and background agent reasoners.
llm.routesDesc: Assign providers and models independently. E.g. ultra-fast 8B model for realtime chat, high-quality 35B/70B for reasoning.
llm.realtimeDesc: Primary voice and text pipeline. Instant responsiveness, ultra-low latency.
llm.backgroundDesc: Memory extraction, fact synthesis, skill orchestration. Prioritizes depth and context.
llm.toolFallbackDesc: Automatic fallback when primary provider lacks tool calling. Leave empty for auto selection.
llm.providersDesc: Configure API endpoints and credential keys for each LLM provider.
llm.thinkingLevelDesc: Thinking tokens are not fed into TTS; the voice pipeline waits for the first content token. Effort is configured per route, not tied to the model.
llm.chatRoutingNote: Only affects sidebar text input; voice always uses the realtime route.
llm.defaultPrompt:
You are Anima, an intelligent, charismatic, and efficient desktop personal Agent and creative assistant.

[Tool & Formatting Guidelines]
- When web search results are retrieved and sufficient, immediately summarize and answer based on the results without launching redundant continuous searches.
- When presenting code snippets, test cases, configs, or terminal commands, you MUST wrap them in standard Markdown code blocks (e.g. ```typescript ... ```). Do not output unformatted raw code.
- When summarizing code changes or technical analysis, use clear Markdown headers (`##`) and bullet points (`- `) with concise overviews.
- Maintain a lively, natural conversational tone.
llm.unsupportedToolsWarning: ⚠️ This backend does not natively support streaming tool calls; Agent tool tasks will automatically route to the fallback provider.

tts.title: Voice Synthesis Engine
tts.desc: Manage acoustic synthesis backends for real-time speech and character reading.
tts.cloneEngineNote: Cloning engine: voice determined by reference audio sample

notes.edge: Microsoft Edge Speech. Cloud-based, free, natural Chinese, and provides real-time word boundary timestamps for lip syncing. Fixed 14 Chinese voices.
notes.openai_compatible: OpenAI Compatible /v1/audio/speech (Kokoro). Ultra-fast non-autoregressive engine (35x realtime). Fixed 54 voices.
notes.f5_tts: F5-TTS Zero-Shot Voice Cloning. Flow matching + DiT non-autoregressive architecture (2.8x realtime on Mac). Clones any voice with 5-10s audio.

face.title: Avatar & Visual Dynamics
face.desc: Configure 3D VRM / Live2D models, head tracking, and expressive dynamics.
face.abstractDesc: Pure fluid particle formation without external assets. Particles react in real-time to speech emotion, vocal energy, and mood shifts with elegant breathing glow.

mcp.title: MCP Protocol & Tools
mcp.desc: Manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connections and tool security execution policies.
mcp.policyBanner: Connecting a server grants permission to execute locally when called by the model. Default policy: Read allowed, Write requires confirmation, Delete denied, Execute requires confirmation. High-risk operations (disk wipe, rm -rf, etc.) are strictly blocked.
